verdict.rationale: CloudConvert exposes an explicitly versioned API ('API v2', with SDKs built against it), so the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guarantees. Pinning a fixed LibreOffice version is an adjacent engine-stability control and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented API deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle and changelog guarantees, and independent corroboration.
